        const splide_list = splide_element.querySelector(".splide__list");

            return;
        const is_mobile = window.innerWidth <= 767;
        if (is_mobile)
        {
            const allCards = splide_list.querySelectorAll(".use_case_item");
            if (allCards.length)
            {
                splide_list.innerHTML = "";
                allCards.forEach(card=>{
                    const slide = document.createElement("div");
                    slide.className =
                        "splide__slide li_item d-flex justify-content-center";
                    slide.appendChild(card.cloneNode(true));
                    splide_list.appendChild(slide);
                });
            }
        }
        new Splide(".use_cases_splide", {
            type: "loop",
            perPage: 1,
            perMove: 1,
            autoplay: false,
            interval: 8000,
            flickMaxPages: 1,
            updateOnMove: true,
            pagination: is_mobile ? false : true,
            throttle: 300,
            focus: is_mobile ? "center" : "left"
        }).mount();
    });

        if (typeof Splide === "undefined")
            return;
        const splide_element = document.querySelector(".use_cases_splide");
        if (!splide_element)
            return;
        const splide_list = splide_element.querySelector(".splide__list");
        if (!splide_list)
            return;
        const is_mobile = window.innerWidth <= 767;
        if (is_mobile)
        {
            const allCards = splide_list.querySelectorAll(".use_case_item");
            if (allCards.length)
            {
                splide_list.innerHTML = "";
                allCards.forEach(card=>{
                    const slide = document.createElement("div");
                    slide.className =
                        "splide__slide li_item d-flex justify-content-center";
                    slide.appendChild(card.cloneNode(true));
                    splide_list.appendChild(slide);
                });
            }
        }
        new Splide(".use_cases_splide", {
            type: "loop",
            perPage: 1,
            perMove: 1,
            autoplay: false,
            interval: 8000,
            flickMaxPages: 1,
            updateOnMove: true,
            pagination: is_mobile ? false : true,
            throttle: 300,
            focus: is_mobile ? "center" : "left"
        }).mount();
    });

        if (typeof Splide === "undefined")
            return;
        const splide_element = document.querySelector(".use_cases_splide");
        if (!splide_element)
            return;
        const splide_list = splide_element.querySelector(".splide__list");
        if (!splide_list)
            return;
        const is_mobile = window.innerWidth <= 767;
        if (is_mobile)
        {
            const allCards = splide_list.querySelectorAll(".use_case_item");
            if (allCards.length)
            {
                splide_list.innerHTML = "";
                allCards.forEach(card=>{
                    const slide = document.createElement("div");
                    slide.className =
                        "splide__slide li_item d-flex justify-content-center";
                    slide.appendChild(card.cloneNode(true));
                    splide_list.appendChild(slide);
                });
            }
        }
        new Splide(".use_cases_splide", {
            type: "loop",
            perPage: 1,
            perMove: 1,
            autoplay: false,
            interval: 8000,
            flickMaxPages: 1,
            updateOnMove: true,
            pagination: is_mobile ? false : true,
            throttle: 300,
            focus: is_mobile ? "center" : "left"
        }).mount();
    });

        if (typeof Splide === "undefined")
            return;
        const splide_element = document.querySelector(".use_cases_splide");
        if (!splide_element)
            return;
        const splide_list = splide_element.querySelector(".splide__list");
        if (!splide_list)
            return;
        const is_mobile = window.innerWidth <= 767;
        if (is_mobile)
        {
            const allCards = splide_list.querySelectorAll(".use_case_item");
            if (allCards.length)
            {
                splide_list.innerHTML = "";
                allCards.forEach(card=>{
                    const slide = document.createElement("div");
                    slide.className =
                        "splide__slide li_item d-flex justify-content-center";
                    slide.appendChild(card.cloneNode(true));
                    splide_list.appendChild(slide);
                });
            }
        }
        new Splide(".use_cases_splide", {
            type: "loop",
            perPage: 1,
            perMove: 1,
            autoplay: false,
            interval: 8000,
            flickMaxPages: 1,
            updateOnMove: true,
            pagination: is_mobile ? false : true,
            throttle: 300,
            focus: is_mobile ? "center" : "left"
        }).mount();
    });

        if (typeof Splide === "undefined")
            return;
        const splide_element = document.querySelector(".use_cases_splide");
        if (!splide_element)
            return;
        const splide_list = splide_element.querySelector(".splide__list");
        if (!splide_list)
            return;
        const is_mobile = window.innerWidth <= 767;
        if (is_mobile)
        {
            const allCards = splide_list.querySelectorAll(".use_case_item");
            if (allCards.length)
            {
                splide_list.innerHTML = "";
                allCards.forEach(card=>{
                    const slide = document.createElement("div");
                    slide.className =
                        "splide__slide li_item d-flex justify-content-center";
                    slide.appendChild(card.cloneNode(true));
                    splide_list.appendChild(slide);
                });
            }
        }
        new Splide(".use_cases_splide", {
            type: "loop",
            perPage: 1,
            perMove: 1,
            autoplay: false,
            interval: 8000,
            flickMaxPages: 1,
            updateOnMove: true,
            pagination: is_mobile ? false : true,
            throttle: 300,
            focus: is_mobile ? "center" : "left"
        }).mount();
    });
